name: html2text
author: Martin Bayer, Arno Unkrig and the html2text contributors
description: html2text turns web pages and HTML files into readable plain text: headings, lists, tables, links. Type curl -s https://example.org | html2text, or html2text page.html.
usage: curl -s URL | html2text [-links] [-width N] | html2text FILE.html. -links lists the link targets at the end.

descriptions.en: html2text turns web pages and HTML files into readable plain text: headings, lists, tables, links. Type curl -s https://example.org | html2text, or html2text page.html.
descriptions.it: html2text trasforma pagine web e file HTML in testo semplice leggibile: titoli, elenchi, tabelle, link. Scrivi curl -s https://example.org | html2text, oppure html2text pagina.html.

does.en: Turns a web page or HTML file into plain text for reading or summarising (no JS-rendered content). Run: curl -s URL | html2text [-links] [-width N]
does.it: Trasforma una pagina web o un file HTML in testo semplice da leggere o riassumere (niente contenuti creati da JS). Uso: curl -s URL | html2text [-links] [-width N]
